title: TITLE: ONE LINE
why: His Q51 (10-18): drop the story paragraph and the three step cards for one line, Ascend. Pillage. Extract. Q53: no raiders beside the logo (none are there). The title is calmer: logo, one line, keys, the mode rows.
now: The title shows one line, Ascend. Pillage. Extract., instead of the story and the three step cards.

edits.anchor:
The elites left the surface to the machines and went somewhere better. You go up, you take what is worth taking, and you come back down.
1 · ASCEND
Take the lift up with whatever you dare carry. What you bring, you can lose.
2 · PILLAGE
Hold E on anything worth opening. Beware of hostile robots and fellow pillagers.
3 · EXTRACT
Stand in a ring and hold E to call for extraction. Die out there and it is all gone.
edits.replacement: Ascend. Pillage. Extract.
